title.zh: 军事演习（射击场）（合并）宣告

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Military Manoeuvres Act
(Chapter 182, Section 8)
Military Manoeuvres (Firing Grounds)
(Consolidation) Proclamation
Proc 3
G.N. No. S 992/1992
REVISED EDITION 1992
(30th April 1994)
The President has by Proclamations declared the areas specified in the Schedule to be firing grounds.
